concept.title: Scenario 9 — Multiple consecutive tables with no paragraph between them
concept.shortdesc: Consider a section where two or more tables appear one after another without any paragraph

conbody.p: Consider a section where two or more tables appear one after another without any paragraph between them.
Result:Each Word table is converted independently into a separate DITA <simpletable> or <table> element. The converter does not automatically merge consecutive tables.
conbody.note: If the tables are logically related, add a short bridging paragraph between them in the .docx document.
